slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: items
slots.about: the ranked things: id, title, source, by, points (votes, the person's own included), comments (a count), voted (true or false), last_rank (the rank at the last visit, 0 when new)

slots.name: hot_points
slots.about: points from which an item gets the hot mark

slots.name: new_word
slots.about: shown beside the rank of an item that was not ranked at the last visit

slots.name: vote_word
slots.about: spoken before the title on the vote button when not voted

slots.name: unvote_word
slots.about: spoken before the title on the vote button when voted

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when there is nothing to rank

attention.shows: a flame under the points from hot_points up; the move since the last visit beside the rank, up or new in accent

labels.vote: vote_word or unvote_word and the title

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: Equal points keep the lower id first: the inner SORTBY orders by id and the outer one is stable.
